statement: On a MinimalNonTerm or CycleMin start, the first even residual always overshoots: T(O^a E)(n) > n and the even residual sits at or above (n+1)^2. The return-to-n cell of the first-even dichotomy is an even-count-1 cycle itinerary, now excluded by no_cycle_itinerary_even_count_le_three. Lean theorems minimal_first_even_overshoots and cycleMin_first_even_overshoots in EvenCountThree.lean. This sharpens the leftover start. It is not a four-even exclusion, not a halt theorem, and not a ReturnBelow law.
